## 1. STRICT RULES & ARCHITECTURE

**1.1 CSS-First Architecture & Zero Inline CSS**
- **No Inline CSS:** the `style="..."` attribute is forbidden anywhere in the HTML.
- **Class/ID Selectors Only:** every design property, layout rule, and state lives in `style.css`, targeted via classes/IDs.
- **Minimal HTML Modifications:** HTML stays clean, semantic, and styling-agnostic — changing the look requires editing only `style.css`.

**1.2 CSS Variables & Theme Tokens**
- Store **all** tokens from Section 0.2 in `:root`, plus: `--radius-sm: 8px`, `--radius-md: 14px`, `--radius-lg: 24px`, `--shadow-sm`, `--shadow-md` (cold, deep shadows), `--spacing-gap: 1.5rem`, `--transition-fast: 150ms`, `--transition-normal: 300ms`, `--ease-standard: cubic-bezier(0.4,0,0.2,1)`, `--z-dropdown: 1000`, `--z-modal: 2000`, `--z-toast: 3000` (plus `--z-header: 900`).
- **Contrast Pairing:** every dark background token pairs with light text tokens and vice versa — enforced in both themes. Aurora Green buttons must carry Deep Midnight `#050B1A` text.
- **Light Mode Background:** never pure white — the light theme uses Snow `#FAFBFC` / Frost `#E8F4F8`; if a near-white is unavoidable, use `#fefefe`, never `#ffffff`.

**1.3 Mandatory Dark Mode Support**
- **Implementation:** Aurora Night (dark) is the default theme at `:root` and under a `.dark` class; the light variant is a **"Polar Day"** frost theme under a `.light` class (Snow/Frost backgrounds, Arctic Blue/Deep Midnight text, `--glass-bg: rgba(250,251,252,0.65)`). Darken accent text colors in light mode (e.g., aurora green text → `#007A4D`, cyan text → `#0077B8`) to preserve ≥4.5:1 contrast.
- **Theme Switching:** background/text variables swap seamlessly with no HTML restructuring.
- **Persistence:** store choice in `localStorage`, fall back to `prefers-color-scheme` on first visit; provide a visible header toggle (Material Symbols `dark_mode`/`light_mode`) with correct `aria-pressed` and dynamic `aria-label`.
- **Exception clause:** the source specification requested a dark-only experience; the mandatory toggle is retained regardless — Aurora Night remains the canonical default, with Polar Day as the compliant light variant.

**1.4 Flexbox Layout & Mobile-First Alignment**
- Build all layout structures with Flexbox.
- **Default Alignment Rule:** every flex container defaults to `align-items: center` unless an exception is explicitly justified (e.g., `stretch` for equal-height card rows).
- **Mobile-Friendly First:** nav row → hamburger dropdown; 3-column card grids → single column; horizontal step connectors → vertical; hero CTA row → column. No horizontal scrolling at any width; minimum touch target 44×44px.

**1.5 Framework Default & Tailwind CSS Integration**
- Use Tailwind CSS (Play CDN acceptable) for **structural layout utilities only**. All component classes (`.btn`, `.card`, `.input-group`, etc.) are defined in `style.css` with BEM naming and consume the `:root` variables. Never mix in another naming convention.

**1.6 Typography & Icons (Google Fonts Mandatory)**
- **Text:** load **Montserrat** (weights 300;400;600;800) via Google Fonts `<link>` with `preconnect`; bind to `--font-base: 'Montserrat', sans-serif`; base body color `#E8F4F8` via `--text-primary`.
- **Icons:** Google Material Symbols only (e.g., `ac_unit`, `dark_mode`, `light_mode`, `auto_awesome`, `insights`, `travel_explore`, `rocket_launch`, `workspace_premium`, `check_circle`, `expand_more`, `close`, `menu`, `star`, `mail`, `arrow_upward`). **Inline SVGs, local icon files, and emoji icons are forbidden.**

## 2. COMPONENT DESIGN SPECIFICATIONS

**2.1 Button Component Requirements** — all states via CSS classes:
- **Default:** `display: flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; gap: 0.5rem;` minimum 44×44px. Variants: `.btn--primary` (Aurora Green fill, midnight text, glow), `.btn--ghost` (frosted glass, aurora border), `.btn--danger` (frostbite red — visually distinct in both themes).
- **Hover:** brightness/glow shift, `cursor: pointer`. **Focus:** distinct ring via `outline`/`box-shadow` using CSS variables. **Active:** `transform: scale(0.97)`.
- **Loading:** disables interaction and double-clicks; CSS spinner or rotating Material icon; button dimensions never change.
- **Disabled:** `opacity: 0.5`, greyscale, `cursor: not-allowed`. **Success/Error:** transient feedback states driven by `--text-success`/`--text-error`.

**2.2 Card Component Requirements** (Features, Testimonials, Pricing):
- **Default:** flex layout, frosted glass recipe from 0.3, `--radius-md`/`--radius-lg`.
- **Hover:** `transform: translateY(-2px)` plus intensified glow. **Focus-within:** border brightens when a child link/button is focused.
- **Loading (Skeleton):** shimmer-sweep `.skeleton` classes matching final dimensions — demonstrate once on the Testimonials cards during a brief simulated initial load.
- **Empty State:** `.card--empty` fallback layout with a Google Icon and guidance text, defined in the CSS component system.

**2.3 Form & Input Requirements** (Final CTA email capture):
- **States:** empty, focused (aurora ring), filled, valid (success border + `check_circle`), invalid (error border, `--text-error` message, error icon), disabled, read-only.
- **Structure:** `.input-group` flex container wrapping label, input, and a dedicated error container with `aria-live="polite"`. Never communicate state by color alone.

**2.4 Modal / Popup Requirements** (subscription confirmation):
- **States:** opening, open, loading, success/error, closing — all animated via CSS transitions.
- **UX:** centered flex overlay (`align-items: center; justify-content: center`), blurred backdrop, Material `close` icon button (44px), keyboard focus trap, close via `Esc` and overlay click, `role="dialog"` / `aria-modal="true"` / `aria-labelledby`, `z-index: var(--z-modal)`.

**2.5 Section-Specific Requirements**
- **Header:** sticky glass bar, aurora bottom border; mobile hamburger opens a dropdown panel (`--z-dropdown`) with `aria-expanded`, animation, and `Esc`/link-click close.
- **Hero:** full-viewport flex column; layered aurora-wave gradient, star field, drifting mist, glacier sheen; shimmer headline; eyebrow tag; subcopy; primary + ghost CTAs.
- **Features:** 3 equal-height glass cards, glowing icon chips, hover lift.
- **How It Works:** 3 numbered steps (01/02/03) with aurora-glow badges and a gradient connector line on desktop, vertical on mobile.
- **Testimonials:** 3 glass cards; avatars are CSS initial-circles with aurora/cyan/pink gradients (no images); `star` icons in `--primary`; skeleton demo per 2.2.
- **Pricing:** 3 tiers; middle tier `.card--featured` with elevated glow, gradient border, and "Most Popular" badge; monthly/annual billing toggle (`aria-pressed`, animated price update, `aria-live` announcement); feature lists with `check_circle`; tier CTAs smooth-scroll to the Final CTA.
- **FAQ:** 5–6 accordion items; question buttons (`aria-expanded`, `aria-controls`) with rotating `expand_more` chevrons; answers animated via `grid-template-rows: 0fr → 1fr`; one-open-at-a-time; fully keyboard operable.
- **Final CTA:** centered glass panel; email `.input-group` + `.btn--primary`; JS validation → invalid state with `aria-live` error, valid → button loading (~1s) → success modal (2.4) + toast; form resets.
- **Footer:** brand blurb, secondary link columns, Material icon links, dynamic copyright year, back-to-top button with smooth scroll; all links have hover/focus glow and 44px targets.
- **Toast:** bottom-positioned, `--z-toast`, `role="status"` / `aria-live="polite"`, auto-dismiss ~4s, success/error variants, slide-in animation.

## 3. CORE UX & MICRO-INTERACTION RULES

- **Responsive by Default:** fluid `clamp()` typography, standard breakpoints, zero horizontal overflow.
- **Smooth Animations:** `transition: var(--transition-normal)` on all state changes; `prefers-reduced-motion` disables aurora-wave, twinkle, mist, shimmer, skeleton sweeps, and entrance reveals.
- **Accessibility (a11y):** ≥4.5:1 contrast in both themes; never color-only state communication; semantic HTML5 (`header`/`nav`/`main`/`section`/`footer`, correct heading order); ARIA on accordion, modal, toggle, toast; logical focus order with a skip-to-content link; full keyboard operability; `aria-live` for all dynamic feedback.
- **Mandatory Visual Feedback:** every click, hover, toggle, and submission triggers a visible state change.
- **Destructive Actions:** `.btn--danger` must be visually distinct in both Aurora Night and Polar Day.
